source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

universe.methodology: 350 U.S. large-cap equities plus 150 non-U.S. liquid equities. The design keeps U.S. comparability while reducing single-market and single-sector concentration bias.
universe.note: Stocks are the investable strategy universe. ETFs are retained separately as risk factors, hedges, and benchmarks.
